build_chat_input: build a chat input from a query and conversation history using ChatGLMTokenizer
build_single_message: build a single chat message with role, metadata, and content tokens using ChatGLMTokenizer
create_sptokenizer: create an SPTokenizer instance from a SentencePiece model file path
encode_text_sptokenizer: encode a text string into a list of integer token IDs using SPTokenizer
decode_token_ids: decode a list of integer token IDs back into a text string using SPTokenizer
